subject: Proposal: 2-year annual prepay with ramped credits — term sheet and concessions
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@brightroute.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Exploring annual prepay vs monthly for 2026

Hey Mina,

Quick question — our finance team is looking at switching BrightRoute to annual prepay for our production usage this year. Right now we’re on monthly billing and it’s getting hard to forecast costs as we scale.

Can you share a straightforward comparison for 1-year vs 2-year prepay (price per token, any onboarding credits, and how you handle ramp months)? I need to get a sense before I loop procurement.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Product, BrightRoute Analytics

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@brightroute.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-04T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Exploring annual prepay vs monthly for 2026

Jordan — thanks for the note and good timing. I attached a concise term sheet (Redwood-Prepay-Term-Sheet-v2.pdf) that lays out two options:

- Option A: 1-year annual prepay (no ramp) — 12% off list per-token rate, 30-day startup credit to smooth billing.
- Option B: 2-year annual prepay with ramped commitments — 18% off list in year 1, 22% off list in year 2 (reflects volume growth guarantee).

Key details in the attachment: ramp schedule (Q1: 60% of committed throughput, Q2: 80%, Q3+: 100%), rollover rules for unused prefix credits, and an onboarding credit we can apply in the first invoice.

Questions for you:
- Do you need an up-front invoice for the full prepay, or are you able to accept a single billed prepay invoice with installment payment terms?
- Any regulatory/KMS constraints for invoice or contract terms?

I’ll copy Monica (sales lead) to flag the ask for possible concessions if BrightRoute needs anything above the standard 18% for a two-year deal. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call with procurement next week.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood-Prepay-Term-Sheet-v2.pdf (6 pages)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-05T08:32:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightRoute — potential 2yr prepay (asking for concession approval)

Monica / Marissa — forwarding the thread with BrightRoute. They’re interested in Option B (2-year with ramp). They’re asking if we can firm up to a 22% blended discount across two years (vs our standard 18% for multi-year).

My proposed concession: 22% blended discount if we: (1) secure a 24-month prepay invoice (or 12-month prepay + committed renewal), and (2) BrightRoute signs by 2026-02-28. Also propose a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of year-1 spend to help with migration costs.

Why I want the concession: BrightRoute is scaling rapidly and has the potential to move more workloads to our dedicated capacity in 2027 — this is a net-new expansion motion if we get favorable terms now.

Please advise whether finance can accept the blended 22% + onboarding credit. If not, what’s the max we can do and any required guardrails (e.g., front-loaded ramp with usage floors)?

Thanks — Mina

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-10T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: BrightRoute — potential 2yr prepay (asking for concession approval)

Mina / Monica — reviewed. Finance can support a concession but with the following conditions:

1) Discount: cap at 20% blended across two years (we can’t accept 22% without a signed exec sales plan).
2) Ramp protections: require a minimum usage floor equal to 60% of committed throughput in year 1; if usage falls below that for any rolling quarter, we reserve the right to claw back credits or accelerate invoicing.
3) Onboarding credit: approve a one-time credit up to 8% of year-1 prepay value, applied to the first month’s invoice.
4) Invoice terms: 45 days net on the prepay invoice OR we can do a 3-installment schedule (30/45/60 days) if procurement needs it documented.

I’ve attached a short spreadsheet with the financial sensitivity (finance_redlines.xlsx) that shows margin impact at 18/20/22% scenarios.

If sales needs more flexibility (22% + 10%), we’ll need an approval path via Sales Ops + Revenue leadership and an expected case that BrightRoute hits specific milestones (e.g., 2x token consumption by end of year 2).

Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: finance_redlines.xlsx
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@brightroute.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-17T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Updated term sheet and payment options for BrightRoute (v3)

Jordan — looping you back with an updated term sheet (Redwood-Prepay-Term-Sheet-v3.pdf) that reflects finance-approved concessions:

- Blended discount: 20% across two years (year 1: 17%, year 2: 23% blended weighting as usage grows).
- Onboarding credit: 8% of year-1 prepay applied to the first invoice.
- Ramp schedule: Q1: 60% floor; Q2: 80%; Q3+: 100%. Clawback mechanics spelled out in section 6.
- Invoice options: full prepay net-45 OR three-installment plan (net-30/45/60).

If these terms look acceptable, I’ve generated a DocuSign powerform (link below) for signature. We’ll attach the signed term sheet to the HubSpot deal and issue the first invoice upon execution.

Suggested next step: procurement + legal to review and sign by 2026-02-28 to lock the pricing. I’m available for a call tomorrow at 11a PT if procurement wants to walk through the ramp language.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123-def456
Attachment: Redwood-Prepay-Term-Sheet-v3.pdf (7 pages)

Best,
Mina

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@brightroute.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightroute.com, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@brightroute.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated term sheet and payment options for BrightRoute (v3)

Mina — thank you. Those updated terms are acceptable to BrightRoute leadership. Procurement will take the DocuSign link and return a signed copy; I’ve asked finance to prepare a PO for the full prepay amount.

Action items on our side:
- We’ll sign the DocuSign powerform by EOD 2026-02-22.
- Procurement will email the PO to billing@redwoodinference.com once internal approvals clear (PO expected by 2026-02-25).

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to getting this live.

Jordan Ellis
Director of Product, BrightRoute Analytics
Attachment: BRIGHTROUTE-PO-8421.pdf (uploaded by procurement after signature)
